dead-bug.criteria: Supine, arms toward ceiling and hips/knees at right angles. Alternate opposite arm and leg extension without trunk motion; controlled return before changing sides.

bird-dog.criteria: Quadruped setup, support hand under shoulder and knee below hip. Alternate opposite arm reaching forward and leg extending back, with stable trunk and pelvis; return before swapping sides.

reverse-crunch.criteria: Supine tabletop-leg variation, arms at sides. Curl pelvis toward trunk while lifting hips and maintaining bent knees. Head, upper trunk and hands remain supported; one-second top pause and controlled return.

limits: Procedural educational demonstration, not motion capture or biomechanical certification.
Sampled mesh-to-mat and joint checks do not certify every cloth/body collision. Production and Android device verification pending.
